visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Two Indices Instead of Shifting
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every time a space is found, all the later characters are shifted one step left. Do the whole job in one pass with a read and a write index. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Shifting the tail for every space costs up to n steps per space, so n squared in the worst case. Filtering with two indices touches each character once.
